1002: Counters for monitoring client-side DC location functionality.
1006: Number of successful DC locator requests per second.
1010: Number of failed DC locator requests per second.
1014: Number of currently active DC locator requests.
1018: Average latency of successful requests in seconds.
1022: The base value used to calculate average success latency.
1026: Average latency of failed requests in seconds.
1030: The base value used to calculate average failure latency.
1034: Number of PDC-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_PDC_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1038: Number of writable-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_WRITABLE_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1042: Number of force-required (cache-bypass) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_FORCE_REDISCOVERY flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1046: Number of site name queries per second.
1050: Number of KDC-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_KDC_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1054: Number of GC-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_GC_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1058: Number of time-server-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_TIMESERV_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1062: Number of DS-required (Windows 2000 or higher) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_DIRECTORY_SERVICE_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1066: Number of DS-required (Windows 2008 or higher) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_DIRECTORY_SERVICE_6_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1070: Number of DS-required (Windows 2012 or higher) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_DIRECTORY_SERVICE_8_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1074: Number of DS-required (Windows 2012 R2 or higher) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_DIRECTORY_SERVICE_9_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1078: Number of DS-required (Windows 2016 or higher) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_DIRECTORY_SERVICE_10_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1082: Number of try-next-closest-site DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_TRY_NEXTCLOSEST_SITE flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
1086: Number of KeyList-support-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_KEY_LIST_SUPPORT_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
